method: Whole-file manual reading of4files; pinned Git byte comparison. No Windows UI runtime execution.
findings: FileTreeView initializes stable enumeration-order columns, binds actual model root on updates and handles selection action via EmulateInteractiveSelection. Shared view declarations own typed watcher/permission/top/duplicate/search controls.

Largest-file default display sort is physical size descending, while top candidate membership from earlier module uses logical size. Display order is not selection criterion. Search default logical descending; duplicate default physical descending.

Hardlink physical-column click only acts when scan settled, resolves index snapshot or linked source and notifies selection. Cursor hand indication itself does not check settled; actionable click guard does.

Proportion tooltip only for node with done parent and cursor in clipped visible bar, using absolute/parent fractions; tooltips cleared on scrolling, click, key and font changes. DONE is model-state marker, not exhaustive scan proof.
Ctrl-left/right selects first visible same-parent directory/file; it does not search entire filesystem or all hidden descendants.
Column width and style initialization describes UI only, no content evidence, freshness checks or duplicate comparison. Base tree/list implementation still requires source review.
limits: No UI routing, stale pointer, tooltip, hardlink navigation or race runtime test.
Tabbed view implementation not read in this increment.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred.
